name: bin point clouds into normalized 2d histograms
definition: convert 2d points into a configurable-size 2D histogram over a given bounding box with entries that sum to one.
failure_mode: wrong normalization, wrong shape, or ignoring bounds fails the histogram tests

name: bulk-load a csv file into the database through the client copy command
definition: Import a local CSV into the table using the client-side copy facility so the load is visible on the server.
failure_mode: Loading by another method lacks the required statement evidence.

name: bundle streaming requests into aligned batches meeting cost/latency and granularity constraints
definition: bundle streaming requests into aligned batches meeting cost/latency and granularity constraints
failure_mode: duplicated/missing ids or a non-multiple shape field breaks the structural checks

name: call an http endpoint carrying a computed payload
definition: send an HTTP request (with a discovered path and body) to an in-container service and read its response to learn the final message.
failure_mode: unreachable/wrong service or malformed payload fails to return it
